reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE cp.product_id IS NULL
alternatives: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM competitor_prices cp RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id WHERE cp.product_id IS NULL
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(cp.product_id) = 0

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING COUNT(cp.product_id) = 0
other_way.tradeoff: Grouping with HAVING COUNT = 0 finds the same products, and it stretches to fewer than 3 checks, which IS NULL cannot do.
